item.title: Toyota Reports 45 Percent Growth In Electrified Vehicle Sales So Far In 2025
item.description: Toyota Motor Philippines reports a 45 percent year-on-year growth when it comes to their electrified vehicle sales. Sales of Toyota and Lexus brands combined showed a total of 16,986 “xEV” sold as of end November.Read More »

item.title: It's Certified: Suzuki Dzire, Fronx Show Impressive Fuel Efficiency
item.description: The Suzuki Dzire Hybrid GLX CVT and the Suzuki Fronx Hybrid SGX AT both posted strong performances at the Department of Energy (DOE) 2025 Fuel Eco-Run held at the Tarlac–Pangasinan–La Union Expressway (TPLEX).Read More »

item.title: Toyota Motor PH To Launch Urban Cruiser EV In 2026
item.description: It looks like the recently-launched bZ4X isn’t the only battery electric vehicle coming from Toyota Motor Philippines. Appearing in the Department or Energy’s list of recognized Battery Electric Vehicles is the Toyota Urban Cruiser EV, almost a year after it was teased for a potential local launch.Read More »

item.title: SMC To Waive Toll Fees This Christmas And New Year's Eve
item.description: San Miguel Corporation will once again waive toll fees across its expressway network this Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve, continuing an annual practice aimed at easing holiday travel.Read More »

item.title: MG Philippines Appoints New President
item.description: SAIC Motor Philippines Inc. (SMPI), the official distributor of MG vehicles in the Philippines, announced a significant leadership transition. Felix Jiang, the pioneering President of SMPI, will be reassigned to MG Australia, while Wei Wei Zhang will assume the role of President of MG Philippines.Read More »

item.title: Geely-Badged Proton Saga, 4 Other New Cars Confirmed For 2026
item.description: Geely shuffled its feet for most of 2025. After they had gained official control of operations in the Philippines, only one all-new car was introduced, (they did refresh the Coolray, Emgrand, and Okavango) and there wasn’t much activity with the cars aside from the usual mall displays. All that is about to change.Read More »

item.title: Tesla Tops Sales Charts, Certified Energy Efficiency In The Philippines
item.description: Tesla ends its first year in the Philippines with a lion’s share of the battery electric vehicle (BEV) market. As of the latest CAMPI-TMA sales data, Tesla has managed to corner a 54 percent BEV market share. More than 2,200 units of the Model 3 and Model Y have been delivered to Filipino customers.Read More »
